description:
This file defines the Twig
ode\WithNode class, which represents a nested 'with' scope in a Twig template engine. It contains methods for constructing the node and compiling it into executable PHP code, handling variable scoping and context management within templates.

classes.name:
Twig
ode\WithNode
classes.description: Represents a nested 'with' scope in a Twig template, managing variable context and scoping during template rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a WithNode with the given body, variables, only flag, and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code, handling context setup, variable assignment, and executing the body node.
